detections.sql:
SELECT 
  le.country, 
  COUNT(DISTINCT u.user_id) as total_users, 
  COUNT(CASE WHEN t.status = 'FAILED' THEN 1 END) as failed_transactions, 
  COUNT(CASE WHEN t.status = 'FAILED' THEN 1 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT u.user_id) as failure_rate
FROM 
  users u 
  JOIN login_events le ON u.user_id = le.user_id 
  JOIN transactions t ON u.user_id = t.user_id
WHERE 
  UPPER(u.account_status) = 'ACTIVE' 
  AND t.status = 'FAILED'
GROUP BY 
  le.country
HAVING 
  failure_rate > 0.05

  COUNT(CASE WHEN t.status = 'FAILED' THEN 1 END) as failed_txns, 
  (COUNT(CASE WHEN t.status = 'FAILED' THEN 1 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(*)) as failure_rate
FROM 
  transactions t

  t.status = 'FAILED'
GROUP BY 
  t.payment_method
